h: Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro visit Joke Silva after Olu Jacobs' death
p: Nollywood veterans Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro have reportedly paid a condolence visit to Joke Silva at her home. Ozokwo had missed Olu Jacobs' funeral because she was working in Ghana.
body: Nollywood veterans Patience Ozokwo and Ebele Okaro have reportedly visited their colleague Joke Silva at home to offer condolences over the death of her husband, the legendary actor Olu Jacobs.

Ozokwo shared a video of the visit on social media on Sunday, 22 November 2026. It showed her signing the condolence register before Joke Silva walked in to welcome the two actresses. In her caption, Ozokwo said she was grateful to be able to spend time with her colleague during such a difficult period.

Olu Jacobs was buried in Lagos on 2 October 2026, at a service attended by family, friends and many colleagues from the entertainment industry. Ozokwo had earlier explained that she could not attend the burial because she was in Ghana on a work engagement.
more: The visit came about seven weeks after the burial.
Ozokwo was in Ghana during the funeral.
Ebele Okaro joined her on the visit.
